name: mem0 for products whose users come back across sessions
gain: Projected only. mem0's own table shows retrieval of about 7K tokens at about 1s p50 on its managed platform (vendor claim); it says the open-source SDK differs. Nothing is measured on this product.
how: Written steps in a tracked issue, not a pull request, because it needs an install and an account or a self-hosted store. Try one memory type behind a switch and compare token use on real conversations.
replaces: A hand-trimmed or hand-summarized message list for a returning user.
trade_offs: It adds a service and a place where user data is stored.
The published scores are for mem0's managed platform and were run by mem0.
It only helps products whose users return across sessions; a single-session chat gains nothing.
needs: An install, plus an account or a self-hosted store. Apache 2.0 for the open-source SDK.
usage_signal: Input tokens per turn grow with conversation length
